name: def280
sql: select p.oid::regprocedure::text sig, pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) d from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='ten280_bot' and p.proname in ('load_ticks','tick','scan')

name: ext
sql: select extname from pg_extension order by 1

name: flipcols
sql: select column_name, data_type from information_schema.columns where table_name='live_flip_log' order by ordinal_position

name: normtest
sql: select normalize('Lehečka', NFD) n, regexp_replace(normalize('Lehečka', NFD), '[\u0300-\u036f]', '', 'g') s
